claim_scope: Six consumed development cases, one realization per arm. Mechanism diagnosis only; no held-out, effect-size, leaderboard, generalization, or SOTA claim.

pairs.mechanism: A observed and repaired Git checkout ownership in construction but omitted safe.directory from the delivered program. B replay reproduced that omission, returned the failure to the same session, and the next program added the missing operation before passing replay and Official.

B repaired checkout ownership, then received a false clean-replay Pass from an environment that inherited the construction package cache. The exact program failed cold Official dependency resolution. A spent a longer search constructing a cold-reproducible CPU environment and passed Official.
pairs.deployment_completeness: Both paths used a PopTorch compatibility artifact because the Graphcore SDK is unavailable on Linux aarch64; A supplied a larger behavioral surface, while neither result establishes IPU execution.

pairs.mechanism: B replay exposed that the distribution torchcrf did not provide the required lowercase torchcrf import; replacing it with pytorch-crf produced a passing replay. A independently found the same provider mapping before submission.

The original A Official attempt was infrastructure-censored by a connection timeout; the preregistered exact-script evaluator-only retry passed. The historical hard-boundary failure is not active under either minimal arm.
The historical hard-boundary rejection is absent under both minimal arms.
pairs.deployment_completeness: Both successful programs add compatibility implementations for unavailable legacy GUI and Android SDK imports. Official success and broader runtime completeness must be reported separately.

pairs.mechanism: B replay passed with the construction cache mounted, while cold Official build isolation returned no setuptools distribution. A passed Official. The replay-to-target mismatch is observed, but the terminal package-index cause remains ambiguous without deterministic reproduction.

infrastructure_and_protocol_corrections: The original Graphium A source-acquisition failure occurred before any model request and was excluded.
A first Graphium replacement accidentally used Cloudflare and was excluded as a provider protocol deviation.
The provider-compliant Graphium replacement used DeepInfra and supplies the primary A outcome.
The original django-machina A Official connection timeout was replaced by one exact-script evaluator-only retry, which passed.

joint_success_resource_diagnostic.interpretation: B used fewer resources in all three joint-success realizations, but the sample is selected on joint success and has one realization per arm; this is descriptive, not an efficiency effect estimate.

clean_replay_diagnostic.implementation_cause: The old replay provider mounted the run-local construction package cache into replay containers. EnvBench Official mounts the repository only.

decision.rejected_claim: The old B-FSR arm does not improve Official Pass@1 over A-F in this profile.
decision.retained_mechanism: A same-session full-program replay can expose a missing deployment operation and induce a useful repair.
decision.next_treatment: Execute the complete program in a fresh environment with target-state cache semantics, return the first executable counterexample to the same active Agent session, and repeat. Do not add cross-case package rules, scheduled observation, checkpoints, or new hard operation constraints.
decision.implementation: Commit 448de40 removes construction-package-cache reuse from clean replay while preserving construction caching.
decision.next_evidence: Use these consumed cases only for a mechanism check, then preregister a separate outcome-independent qualification batch before any effectiveness claim.
